raw_text: AIS signal for MV Galaxy Leader (IMO 9237307) went dark approximately 45 minutes ago in the southern Red Sea near coordinates 14.5N 42.8E. Last recorded speed was 12.3 knots on a heading of 338 degrees. The vessel is a Bahamian-flagged vehicle carrier operated by NYK. Multiple vessels in the area have also reported losing AIS contact. This is unusual and could indicate a jamming event or worse.
